1,051 likes, 6 comments - beebomco on October 11, 2026: "The World’s Fastest Android Phones With The Fastest Processors Are Finally Here! Qualcomm has launched two new flagship processors, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6, at IMC 2026.

The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 is built on a 2 nm process, with 37% better CPU power efficiency than the previous generation. The CPU is 13% faster, and the GPU is 44% faster, with matrix cores and Adreno Neural Fusion. The NPU is 35% faster. This results in faster app loading, better gaming performance and faster, more capable on-device AI.

The chipset also supports 8K video recording at 60 FPS and 4K video recording at 240 FPS. The iQOO 16 and the Motorola Signature 27 will be the first phones in India to come with this processor.

The Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 is also built on a 2 nm process. Compared to the Gen 5, it has a 10% faster CPU, a 35% faster GPU and a 14% faster NPU. The Xiaomi 18 Pro will be the first phone to come with this chipset.

All three phones were on display at the Qualcomm booth at IMC 2026.".

127K likes, 1,573 comments - beebomco on October 10, 2026: "The Illegal Calculator!

This is a scientific calculator that looks and works like a regular one. It handles addition, subtraction, multiplication and trigonometric functions like Sin, Cos and Tan, along with the other functions you would expect.

But, entering 1 2 3 4 5 6 unlocks a hidden chat mode. In this mode, you can type messages using the number keys, similar to old keypad phones.

The calculator connects to a phone over Bluetooth. You can send messages from the calculator to the phone, and the phone can send messages back to the calculator.

It can also search the internet. You type what you want to search for, press the Tan button, and the result appears on the calculator’s screen.

The calculator has built-in memory that can store large amounts of text. You can scroll through the saved text on the screen and delete it instantly.

When you are done, pressing a button switches the calculator back to its regular calculator mode.".

1,641 likes, 38 comments - beebomco on October 9, 2026: "5 Best Snapdragon-Powered Laptops To Buy This Festive Season

Deal Details:

Lenovo Yoga Slim 7X with the latest Snapdragon X2 Plus - Just 89,990* (Croma)

HP Omnibook 3 (X) - Starts 46,990* (Flipkart)

ASUS Vivobook 14 (X) - Just 50,990* (Flipkart)

ASUS Vivobook S14 Flip (X)- Just 89,990* (Flipkart)

Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 (X) - 56,990* (Flipkart)

If you’re getting a laptop this festive season, Snapdragon X Series laptops are worth considering. Snapdragon X brings multi-day battery life, class-leading CPU and NPU performance, and a design made for powerful everyday computing on Windows.

The Lenovo Yoga Slim 7x comes with the latest Snapdragon X2 Plus. It has an OLED display in a 13.9mm slim body, and its 80 TOPS NPU handles AI work on the device itself. It is available for ₹89,990 during the sale.

The ASUS Vivobook 14 is a good option for students. It is powered by Snapdragon X and comes with 16GB RAM, which handles classes and multiple browser tabs. It has a solid build and more than 25 hours of battery life. During the sale, it is available for ₹50,990.

The ASUS Vivobook S14 Flip is a 2-in-1 laptop with a 14-inch OLED touchscreen and an all-metal body. The display flips around for movies or tablet-style use, and the laptop supports a stylus. It is powered by Snapdragon X and offers up to 25 hours of battery life. It is available for ₹89,990 during the sale.

The HP OmniBook 3 is a slim and light laptop powered by Snapdragon X. It ships with a compact GaN charger, and HP claims up to 36 hours of battery life. It is available for ₹46,990 during the sale.

The Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 is the pick for those who want a larger display. It has a 15.3-inch screen, Snapdragon X, 16GB RAM and a 512GB SSD, along with more than 20 hours of battery life. It is available for ₹56,990 during the sale.".

9,234 likes, 69 comments - beebomco on October 8, 2026: "Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra: Everything New!

The all-new Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra is a flagship Android tablet that measures just 5.1mm in thickness. It comes with a 14.6” 3K AMOLED panel with very slim bezels, which gets you a large, immersive screen.
The display gets up to 1600 nits of brightness and supports HDR content. An anti-reflective coating cuts down on glare. Audio is handled by four speakers with Dolby Atmos support.

Inside, the tablet is powered by the Dimensity 9500 chipset, paired with 12GB of RAM and up to 512GB of storage. Storage can be expanded up to 2TB.

The Tab S12 Ultra runs One UI 9 based on Android 17. AI features include Audio Eraser, which removes background audio from videos, and Creative Studio, which creates stickers and invitations. You can also run up to 3 apps at once for multitasking. Samsung promises 7 years of OS updates, and Samsung DeX lets you connect the tablet to a larger display.

The S Pen comes in the box. This is also the first Android tablet to come with Photoshop, which includes generative fill.

The tablet packs an 11,600mAh battery and has an IP68 rating for dust and water resistance.

For those who want a smaller option, there is also the Galaxy Tab S12+. It has a 12.6” AMOLED display, the same processor and a 10,600mAh battery.

#Samsung #GalaxyTabS12 Plus #GalaxyTabS12Ultra #GalaxyTabS12 #GalaxyAI".

Airtel is increasing the prices of its postpaid plans starting tomorrow. The ₹449 postpaid plan will now cost ₹499, and the ₹699 plan will go up to ₹749.

So is it good or bad? 😐".
